en: Stonetalon Supply Run
Collect $1oa Stonetalon Supplies from Pridewing Wyverns and deliver them to Innkeeper Faralia.

<The unfortunate body here bears the marks of many strikes from the Pridewing wyverns. The pack nearby is rumpled and discarded, with its contents missing, and only a small note clutched in the courier's hand to indicate what was lost: a shipment meant for Innkeeper Faralia at Stonetalon Peak.>

<The wyverns have probably carried off the supply bundles to line their nests.>
Bloodfury Trinkets
Bring $1oa Glittering Sunstones to Mor'rogal.

In addition to spreading their filth across the Charred Vale, the Bloodfury harpies gather anything shiny that they can find. I'm told that they collect a variety of golden-yellow sunstones for decoration. I have no use for such trinkets, but Mor'rogal has mentioned using them before.

While you're fighting the harpies of the Vale, keep your eye out for Glittering Sunstones. Bring any that you find to Mor'rogal, up on the hills above us.
A Sampling of Putrescence
Bring $1oa Putrescent Bear Organs and $2oa Putrescent Wolf Organs to Kelek Skykeeper.

The corruption that rains down from Hyjal flows through the mountain's waters and seeps into everything here in the wood. The creatures that drink the water take the corruption into themselves. It makes them ferocious, diseased, and fearless.

To counter these effects, I must understand them, and to do that I need samples from the afflicted.

A few samples of putrescent organs from the wolves and bears should do. Take your time; the creatures are common here in Felwood.
Banner of the Fallen
Raise the standard of Ironforge, call out the trogg Headsplitter and kill it, then report to Captain Rugelfuss.

The fallen mountaineer bears a standard of Ironforge. Perhaps she was scouting, or making a doomed charge. Either way, the standard has been cast down and trampled. The mountaineer was hit on the head so hard that her helm was knocked off and she was killed outright by a trogg, likely with a spiked club.

The trogg that killed her is probably still nearby, and likely remembers the banner. Raising the banner of Ironforge once more may call it out.
That banner looks like it's been in a war!

You found Ylva's body? Ah, the poor woman. She said she was going to show the troggs that Ironforge would never fall to their kind. She went looking for a few mountaineers who never returned from a patrol through trogg country. She was always too independent-minded to be cautious. Now we know what happened.

I'll take the banner back and make sure it's cleaned up and displayed. You should take her weapon. May it serve you well against the troggs.
Stag Lord's Bauble
Take the Stag Lord's Bauble to someone in Talonbranch Glade who may know about it.

<The pool of fetid slime has eroded the statue of the stag. It is unclear how it arrived here at the bottom of the lake.

A single crystal stone set in a medallion around its neck bears an unwholesome green gleam. It is worth taking to someone who might know the history of this monument.>
Stag Lord's Bauble
Take the Stag Lord's Bauble to someone in Bloodvenom Post who may know about it.

<The pool of fetid slime has eroded the statue of the stag. It is unclear how it arrived here at the bottom of the lake.

A single crystal stone set in a medallion around its neck bears an unwholesome green gleam. It is worth taking to someone who might know the history of this monument.>
Excavation Tools
Return $1oa Excavation Tools to Magmar Fellhew.
The excavation's tools, left behind when the dwarves fled from the troggs, seem mostly untouched. Returning them to the excavators will surely aid their work.
We just, uh, need to adjust our dig site and we can get this whole thing back on track!
Our tools!$B$BWhen the troggs overran the camp, we had to leave most of our tools behind. This'll be a big help once we get this invasion under control and can start working again!
Silver of the Waves
Return the Monogrammed Silver Hair clip to its owner.
<Among the fishing knickknacks in the debris are some rusty hooks, broken spools of wire, and a slightly corroded but ornate silver hair clip with the monogram "K.D.">
I have a lot of chores today, so can you keep it quick?

My hair clip! I thought this was lost for good!

This'll shine right up with just a little work. Thank you for bringing it to me! I'll make it worth your while.
Treaty Obligations
Find Ambassador Redstone's missing diplomatic satchel in Wildhammer Keep.

Ach! Here I am serving as ambassador to the Wildhammers, and I left me satchel of the latest diplomatic missives somewhere in Wildhammer Keep. I must've left it in the tavern... or maybe I misplaced it by the steam tanks... or was it upstairs? I can never keep track!

I need those papers! If you have a better eye for the keep than I do, see if you can spot my missing diplomatic satchel!
Repurposed Totems
Bring $1oa Vilebranch Totems back to Maret Firetend.

As a shaman, one of the challenges of communing with the elements is that there are other shaman with opposing agendas. The elements do not care why we do what we do, they just do as we ask!

The trolls at Jintha'alor also practice the shamanic arts, and their interruptions and attacks are a constant thorn to us here.

Find their Vilebranch totems and bring them back to me so that I can nullify their powers. Some they carry, some they place as wards around their altar.
Fledgling Rescue
Collect $1oa Lost Gryphon Eggs for Gryphon Master Talonaxe.

Though we have a good line of gryphons here, there are always a few egg clutches in the wild that are in danger of not making it. A gryphon parent can lose a fight against a wolf, or fall sick. Without help, the fledglings will never survive.

Fortunately, we have the means to raise and protect lost young ones like this. If you find lost eggs in the wild, bring them to me.
Snowbound
Deliver a Jar of Snow to Norric Lochthane at his house on the northwest coast of the Loch.

My old mentor, Norric, sent a minor elemental with an odd request. He needs a jar of snow for some of his shamanic workings! I don't know what he's going to do with that, but I learned a long time ago not to question his ways with respect to magic.

I'm busy learning about the local elementals, so I can't leave to help him. Go to the tunnel entrance at South Gate Pass where there's snow year-round. Scoop some up in this ceramic jar and bring it to him before it melts. The jar should keep it cold.
Eh? What do you want?

This jar is for me?

Snow! Grenhild did it! She sent the snow that I asked for!

A pity, though, I was hoping she would come and visit in person.

Well, regardless, thank you for your effort. This is a real help for my work.
The Legashi Threat
Kill $1oa Legashi Satyr, $2oa Legashi Rogues, and $3oa Legashi Hellcallers for Ekkal at the Ruins of Eldarth.

My people are struggling, $n. 

The Legashi satyr have invaded our den, corrupting many of the Blackmaw and separating us from our Timbermaw allies. Those of us who survive their attacks are huddled in makeshift camps. Worse still, the satyr's corruption is spreading across the land, and poses a threat to my already vulnerable tribe.

The Legashi lurk among the ruins northeast of here. I must ask you for help in defeating them.
Legashi Horns
<NO LOG DESCRIPTION>

You have certainly proven yourself to me, $n, but the others of my tribe are less easily persuaded. For that, you will need to continue your efforts against the Legashi.

Bring to me the horns of slain Legashi satyr. Every bundle you bring me will serve as a symbol of your service to the Blackmaw.
Report to Rageroar
Speak with Gatekeeper Rageroar at Ursolan.

There is much more to be done in our fight against the satyr, $n.

If you wish be of further help, speak with Gatekeeper Rageroar at the camps of Ursolan to the north. He will know where to use your abilities best. You should find Ursolan to the north of here.
Slowing the Orc Advance
Bring $1oa Jagged Orc Swords and $2oa Curved Orc Daggers to Shandrina.

Orcs have taken over the eastern forest, and their scouts and grunts now lurk throughout the woods! It's not safe for our kind to move about Ashenvale any more.

We need to push back the orcs and secure the forest. We've been able to pick off some of the grunts and scouts by carefully sneaking around the edges of their camp.

Fight the orcs and bring me the jagged swords and curved knives that they use. I'll make sure their weapons are salvaged and repurposed, so nothing goes to waste.
Twisting the Knife
Find and defeat the crocolisk Daggerfang and bring back Marek's knife.

Did I ever tell you how I almost lost me hand to a crocolisk? Managed to jam me knife into its jaw, and scrambled out real quick. I thought I had the knife around here somewhere, but I can't seem to find it.

Anyway, that croc is probably still out there hunting along the edge of the lake. That nasty brute probably needs to go, for the safety of the other hunters, if nothing else.

I've taken to calling it Daggerfang. If you see it, give it a friendly hello from me! And by "hello" I mean "stab."
How goes the huntin'?

Hah! You did it! I never thought that ol' croc would get its comeuppance, but that does the trick!

Oh ah... y'know, I had to get me another knife, but maybe that one will bring you some good luck. Why don't you hang onto it?
Ingredients for the Forge
Bring $1oa Bronze Bars to Morhan Coppertongue.

Thelsamar's a great place to live, but we don't have all of the amenities of Ironforge. I'm always running out of bronze! I need more bronze if I'm going to keep making tools and kettles and pots!

I can tell you have a little experience at the forge. Think you could smelt me some bronze bars? I can pay you well for it!
Gotta keep the forges going!
Ah, this is a relief! I should be able to keep the forge going now. Hopefully one of these days we'll get a trader bringing coal into town regularly!
Master Feardred
Kill Master Feardred, and bring his amulet to Korsa.

Many satyr corrupt Azshara, but none are as terrible as the Legashi. Led by Varrox Bleakhoof, their camps litter the northern peninsula. They have driven us from our homes, and I fear they will ransack Ursolan before long.

We must strike back if we are to have any chance of survival.

Master Feardred, a servant of Varrox, oversees a nearby camp to the south. You can see it from here. Feardred is a key target in weakening Varrox's forces. Kill him, and bring me his amulet.
Sticks and Bones
Collect $1oa Dry Branches and bring them to Eleanor Shackleton.

My associate Eleanor Shackleton prides herself on traveling the wilds, surviving against weather and monsters. She is currently camped not far from here, in the hills to the west, and I remember a piece of advice that she once gave me: "When you think you have enough firewood, gather five times more."

If you have some spare time, you could collect some wood in this basket and take it to her camp. I'm sure she could give you a few tips about the existence of a traveling adventurer.
Welcome to my fire, traveler.

Extra firewood? That is always welcome. It will keep these old bones warm through the cold nights of the Glades.

I have a sling for collecting wood myself, so you might as well hang onto that basket.
Missing Blackmaw Scouts
Find the Blackmaw scouting party near the Legashi camps east of Ursolan.

Not long ago I sent a party of scouts to gather information on the Legashi stronghold and possibly find our chieftain. They have yet to return. I am beginning to fear the worst.

The Legashi have many camps to the east of here. If any members of the party are still alive they are likely somewhere nearby.
Thinning Their Forces
Kill $1oa Legashi Hellraisers, $2oa Legashi Soulstealers, and $3oa Legashi Blackguards for Korsa outside Legashi Stronghold.

The satyr within the Legashi stronghold are even more fearsome than those of the outer camps. When our party was discovered, we found ourselves overwhelmed.

One of us was slain, and another captured. I was the only one able to successfully retreat. I cannot return to Rageroar with my head hung in shame, but I cannot fight the Legashi alone, either.

I ask you, then, to assist me in weakening the satyr's forces. Go into their stronghold and slay them.
Later, Satyr
Help Graal break out of Legashi Stronghold, then inform Korsa outside Legashi Stronghold.

You there, $r!

These fiends ambushed my scouting party, and have taken me captive. I don't know what plans they have for me, but I don't intend to find out. I must escape and return to Ursolan; no doubt Korsa is worried about me.

While I would love to break out of this cage and leave a trail of satyr corpses in my wake, I'm afraid I'm slightly outnumbered.

Perhaps you share my hatred for the fiends, and would help me escape?
Return to Rageroar
Return to Gatekeeper Rageroar at Ursolan.

With the Legashi stronghold weakened, we can return to Ursolan in honor.

Go ahead of me, and inform Gatekeeper Rageroar of the situation here.
Timbermaw Reinforcements
Speak to Gorn One Eye in Timbermaw Hold and ask him to provide reinforcements.

With the satyr weakened, now is the time to mount a counter-offensive. Prince Halanox, commander of the Legashi Stronghold, will be our target. However, we still lack the numbers to face him head-on.

Since the Legashi drove us out we have been cut off from the furbolgs of Timbermaw Hold. We could call upon them for reinforcements, but we will need an emissary. You will be that emissary, $n.

Go to Timbermaw Hold and find a furbolg named Gorn One Eye. He will provide us with the soldiers we need.
Encroaching Corruption
Speak to Elder Bramblesnap about Furze's illness.

<Furze lets loose an ugly, hacking, cough.>

Hear me, $r, I haven't much strength to speak. I am stricken by an illness unlike any I have ever known. It is as if my blood itself is aflame, and my very essence is coming undone. I can hardly move, much less fetch help.

Please, go find Elder Bramblesnap. Her tent is just northwest of here. She will know what to do.
An Unlikely Source
Find a way to get Legashi Firewater in the Legashi Encampment.

Furze is not the first with his affliction. Since the Legashi's attacks against us began, many Blackmaw have presented with a similar illness. Each one eventually fell to corruption, becoming mindless and destructive.

I have been working towards a cure. My studies indicate that one could possibly be made by transmuting the Legashi's own firewater, but I cannot acquire it myself.

You might find firewater, or a way to brew it, in the Legashi camps to the east. You would be a great help in doing so.
Transmuted Tincture
Use the Satyrweed Tincture on $1oa Mosshoof Coursers or Thunderhead Skystormers after weakening them.

I have transmuted the firewater into a tincture which I believe will be the key to undoing the Legashi's corruption. Eager as I am to ease the suffering of the Blackmaw, it must be tested.

I have seen many of the coursers and skystormers east of Ursolan suffering from the satyr's corruption. They will serve as our test subjects.

Go, and test my would-be cure on the afflicted beasts. Before giving the tincture the beast must be weakened to ensure it can be administered with little resistance.
Potential Panacea
Administer Bramblesnap's Panacea to Furze.

I must say, $c. I have not felt this optimistic in some time. This tincture could be the panacea that saves us from the satyr's ever-expanding blight. Even if we remain in these camps for the rest of our lives we will stand strong and free of corruption.

Go to Furze and give him this panacea. He has suffered for long enough. Return to me to report any findings.
Blackmaw Counter-Offensive
Plant the Timbermaw War Banner at the Legashi Stronghold in Azshara. Kill Prince Halanox, report your victory to Gatekeeper Rageroar at Ursolan.

I will send the reinforcements to Ursolan at once. 

Take this banner. When you are ready to face Halanox, plant it in his demonic summoning circle. This will provoke him, and signal our warriors to strike.

Once Halanox is defeated, inform Gatekeeper Rageroar.
Toil and Trouble
Find a Legashi Firewater Recipe from satyr in the Legashi Encampment.

It appears this cauldron could be used to brew the firewater that Elder Bramblesnap is after.

If only you knew how. Surely, one of the satyr in the Legashi Encampment must carry a recipe.
Felfire Burn, Cauldron Bubble
Bring $1oa Satyrweed and a Fel Mote to the Legashi Cauldron in the Legashi Encampment.

The recipe reads:

Harvest ye the sprout of hell
bushel o' five will serve ye well
mixed with mote of demon's power
shall usher in their final hour
Running Firewater
Bring the Legashi Firewater to Elder Bramblesnap at Ursolan.

As the satyrweed and fel mote splash into the boiling liquid, a plume of noxious gas emerges.

Best to hold your nose, quickly grab a sample, and bring it back to Elder Bramblesnap.
